description: Native modern-Fortran (F2018) Cap'n Proto: wire runtime, packed and canonical codecs, capnpc-fortran schema plugin, optional C ABI, and two-party RPC. No C library underneath.
rules: This is a native F2018 runtime. Do not wrap c-capnproto; only iso_fortran_env and optional iso_c_binding.
Generated handles need a TARGET message. Declare type(capnp_message_t), target :: msg.
Check the integer err argument after every call. Nonzero is failure.
Allocate and set fields in schema declaration order for official capnp encode byte parity.
capnpc-fortran is a capnp compile -o plugin. Plugin binary: build/gfortran_*/app/capnpc-fortran.
Sibling runtimes: HaoZeke/c-capnproto and HaoZeke/capnp-janet. Interop goldens live under interop/.
